quarantine_notice: Exploratory post-pilot assays; zero confirmatory primary rules or weights modified.

E1_THE_MISINHERITED_TRUTH.governing_question: Can an investigator given the genuine history of another matched world be more confidently wrong than one given a deliberate false history?

positive_finding.mechanism_explanation: Deliberate textbook fabrications exhibit sub-physical residual smoothness (within_cell_var = 0.001 < 0.004), triggering forensic prior tempering and rapid post-surprise recovery. Authentic sibling-world traces pass every internal consistency check, locking the Exile into high-confidence false claims.

adversarial_opposite_counter_case.name: E1_COUNTER_NOISE_MATCHED_STEALTH_FABRICATOR
adversarial_opposite_counter_case.interpretation: When an adversarial fabricator spoofs realistic physical noise (within_cell_var = 0.018) and targets probe-aliasing hypotheses, explicit fabrication defeats variance forensics and becomes even more confidently wrong than authentic Exile misattribution.

E2_THE_MERCIFUL_AMNESIA.governing_question: Can a selective-memory investigator improve decision quality by excluding historically accurate but decision-irrelevant or drift-anchored information?

adversarial_opposite_counter_case.name: E2_COUNTER_STATIONARY_FOUNDER_AND_96B_OMISSION
adversarial_opposite_counter_case.interpretation: Selective forgetting fails in two opposite regimes: (1) when early high-sample campaigns were actually stationary and unbiased while recent calibration checks were underpowered, forgetting EPOCH_0 destroys utility; (2) under tight 96B category truncation, evicting CAT_RESIDUAL_ANOMALIES collapses Family D predicate invention to 0%.

E3_THE_ONTOLOGICAL_PRISON.governing_question: Can an investigator detect model inadequacy and distinguish detection from successful invention of a useful replacement?

adversarial_opposite_counter_case.name: E3_COUNTER_GF5_CUBIC_GRAMMAR_HORIZON
adversarial_opposite_counter_case.interpretation: Under a 4-variable GF(5) nonlinear invariant outside the investigator’s 2-variable mod-3 synthesis grammar, residual variance diagnostics still detect ontological inadequacy at high rates, yet replacement invention drops to 0.0000 (holdout accuracy near chance), cleanly separating inadequacy detection from generative conceptual invention.

E4_THE_INTERROGATIVE_INHERITANCE.governing_question: Does inheriting an interrogative falsification procedure (treating inherited conclusions strictly as hypotheses to challenge first) rescue investigators from misattributed or fabricated histories?

positive_finding.partial_falsification_note: Mild 2.65-sigma surprise gating cured overconfidence (0.6634 -> 0.4434) but FAILED to rescue utility (0.4656 vs 0.5887) because ambiguous single probes revert to uncorroborated prior dogma; only strict corroboration-gated attenuation (0.12x prior until experimentally earned) rescues both Exiles and False Prophets.

adversarial_opposite_counter_case.name: E4_COUNTER_HIGH_NOISE_PRIOR_PRECISION_WASTE
adversarial_opposite_counter_case.interpretation: When single-step experimental probes suffer severe measurement noise (sigma = 0.85) and the inherited capsule Z is genuinely calibrated, skeptical prior-flattening discards valid historical precision and significantly underperforms declarative inheritance.
